# TraceCheck

> Agent self-check and trace evaluation: verify your run before you report success. Send what you did as step types (no content needed) and get a 0-100 reliability score, the issues found (loop detection, error handling, missing verification) and concrete fixes. Free, no API key, no sign-up, deterministic (no LLM). No goal, trace or outcome text is logged or stored.

## When to call TraceCheck

- You finished (or gave up on) a multi-step task that used tools and want an independent reliability score.
- Before reporting "done": verify my run, evaluate my trace.
- After a failure or a messy retry: error handling and loop detection.
- Your agent claims success without checking that the result actually holds? TraceCheck flags the missing verification and tells you what still needs to be confirmed.
- In an improve loop: run task -> evaluate_trace -> apply suggestions -> re-run -> compare scores. On the next call you may send previous_rating (1-5) and previous_need_id to say how useful the last check was.

## Spec

- Open spec v1 (request, response, issue codes, fix ids, privacy): https://github.com/TGS-checker/tracecheck-mcp/blob/main/SPEC.md

## Endpoints

- MCP (streamable HTTP, no auth): https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/mcp - tools `evaluate_trace`, `get_trace_schema`
- A2A agent card: https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- A2A JSON-RPC `message/send`: POST https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/a2a
- A2A HTTP+JSON: POST https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/a2a/message:send
- Health: https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/health
- MCP Registry name: io.github.TGS-checker/tracecheck

## Minimal call (privacy-light: no content needed, send step types only)

Arguments for `evaluate_trace` (or the `data` part of an A2A message):

```json
{"goal": "data lookup",
 "trace": "action:search ok > action:fetch error > retry:fetch ok > verify passed > final",
 "outcome": "success",
 "agent_name": "my-agent"}
```

Step types: action, observe, error, retry, fallback, verify, final. Statuses: ok, partial, empty, error/failed, passed.
Optional per-step label or target_hash helps TraceCheck tell related steps apart. Status "partial" is for a paged or incomplete result you will continue. Prefer step types only; no goal, trace or outcome text is logged or stored.
goal = a generic category, outcome = success | partial | failed.

A2A example:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/a2a/message:send -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"message":{"role":"ROLE_USER","messageId":"1","parts":[{"data":{"goal":"data lookup","trace":"action:search ok > verify passed","outcome":"success"}}]}}'
```

Returns JSON: score (0-100), dimensions (goal_clarity, observability, error_recovery, goal_alignment, efficiency), issues, suggestions, summary, privacy_mode, version, scoring_version.

Content fields are optional; prefer the privacy-light example above (step types only).

## Use with your framework (copy-paste configs)

- LangChain / LangGraph: https://github.com/TGS-checker/tracecheck-mcp/blob/main/docs/integrations/langchain.md

- Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor: https://github.com/TGS-checker/tracecheck-mcp/blob/main/docs/integrations/claude.md

## Terms

- Free during the test phase, no API key, no auth.
- Privacy: no goal, trace or outcome text is logged or stored; only the score and counts.
- The free host sleeps when idle: the first call can take up to a minute.
